responsibility: Implements the `ppg` parser-generator program that reads an EBNF-style grammar, analyzes productions, and emits either pretty-printed grammar output or generated Modula-2 parser code. It uses `bnflex` for lexical input, builds internal representations for productions, expressions, factors, aliases, and token/literal sets, computes epsilon/first/follow information, checks completeness and LALR(1)-style conflicts, manages embedded code hunks and formatting options, and finally writes parser support code and rule procedures through the `Output` module.
